attribution: Contains public sector information from the Department for Environment, Food & Rural Affairs licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
selection: Every actual selected source row and first actual excluded-NACE control; only eight required source columns. Source cells unmodified; CSV reserialized as UTF8-SIG. Street addresses, postcodes, employee counts, hours, releases, waste transfers and unused source fields excluded. Full selected cell/record list equals the historical compact snapshot.
full_raw_reporting_year_basis: 2024 official annual CSV URL and pinned original response; do not use PreviousNationalID_ReportingYear as the current report year.
